_note: Per-host page preparation for live captures (host without www.). click: button labels, first visible exact match wins (case-insensitive); presses: how many times to press it (default 1). clickText: click the innermost element whose text contains this (interstitials). block: URL substrings to abort (tool overlays that are not part of the design). wait: extra ms to settle before screenshots. scrollFrames: for scroll-driven pages, save up to N viewport frames while wheel-scrolling (scroll-<w>-NN.png); tiles.py uses them in place of the full-page shot. Prefer reject or essential-only on cookie banners. Everything applied is recorded in manifest.json prep; a banner that stays up keeps the item not verified (evals/testset/results/live-capture-notes.md).
